name: careernest-root
description: CareerNest — Internship Application Tracker (MERN Stack End-Term Project)

scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true});"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install

author: Student Project
